report_summary: Read-only internal reread completed against the latest supervisor route, Codex return, internal-read contracts, Paperclip/top-layer locks, and integrated-engine API/shell seams. The stable direction is an engine-level operating surface with work packet, team assignment, worker report, supervisor route/gate, internal-read report, and audit/guard boundaries.
